fusions.name: Glint Shoal
fusions.desc: Looses 3 silver glints at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage and having a 25% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Landed Catch
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 18 damage to a target at or below 25% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow. You move 15% faster for 5 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Slipped Grip
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Prey Pattern
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you have 12% more dodge chance.
